title: Top words, sorted and case-insensitive
prompt:
`word_counts` in src/lib.rs returns a `HashMap`, so the report prints words in random order and counts "The" and
"the" separately. Replace it with `top_words(text, n) -> Vec<(String, usize)>`: words are lowercase, made of letters,
digits and apostrophes (punctuation around them does not count), sorted by count (highest first) then alphabetically,
at most `n` of them. Update the existing callers and tests.
